text_block_list.text:
Today is Winning Ticket's debut race, a
special day for the fledgling
runner.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guys! Thanks sooo much for coming
all the way to Hakodate to
root for me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We'd do anything for a
teammate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is your time to shine.
And we'll cheer
enough to make up for the
members who
couldn't come.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We'll hafta have one heck of a dinner
after the race! Scallops and sea
snails! Rice
bowls with crab, sea urchin, and salmon
roe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And melon parfaits! Don't forget the
melon parfaits!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh... So the food's why you really came?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what ever do you mean?! A fine meal
is simply a bonus! Never
mind that—you
need to concentrate!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Focus, focus... All righty,
Trainer, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Okay! This is my first step on the road to
the Derby! I've got this win
down!

Ticket heads toward her big dream, fully
confident in her victory.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaagh! I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut it! How many times are you gonna
wail about losing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... Don't be so mean. We've been friends since we started at the academy. Can't you at least comfort me a little?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You'd still end up crying about it even
if I
did.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah—because this is my start
toward the Derby, you know?
The road's
still so long, and I stumbled on the first
step...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you had such high hopes. I can
comprehend how you must feel.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Riiight?! What am I gonna do if this means
I can never get into the
Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Enough already! Losing your debut race
doesn't mean your dreams are
crushed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I lost my debut, but I'm still gonna show everyone one day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. You need to recover your
footing. Save the despair for
when your
dream is truly quashed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, you've got an unstoppable spirit,
Taishin! And Hayahide, you stay cool on
the outside and burn for a fight on the
inside! I won't stay
here crying!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop if I wanna win the Derby!
Thanks, you two! Nothing's
better than
having friends by y-your... Uwaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
See, you ended up crying anyway! Can't
you just be quiet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her emotions are also her strength. We'd
do well to learn from that.

The team is all together, putting some
needed training time in.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nnnraaagh! To the Derbyyy!

Post-race training is usually light, but
Winning Ticket is running with
all her
might as if she has an upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Goodness... Ticket has so much energy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I thought she'd still be reeling after
yesterday. That's some weird
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She said her friends helped lift her
spirits.
What wonderful people
they must be to
understand her dream.

It wouldn't make sense for us to dwell
on a
single setback when our
sights are set on
the Derby.

Since she's still running toward her dream
with her head held high, I
have to do all I
can to help her achieve it!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Tickezo! Swing those arms harder!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: 'Kaaay!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Pay attention to your stride! Keep pushing
it till the very end!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Pay attention to your stride! Keep pushing
it till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pushing iiiiit! To the very eeend!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Phew! Finished! Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Don't forget to ice up to get
rid of that fatigue.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Don't forget to ice up to get
rid of that fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right!
But I thought I'd run just a little bit
longer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I might have lost my debut race, but my
friends have helped me get
over it, and
your passionate coaching has me all fired
up again...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It feels like that loss wasn't for nothing. My drive for the Derby's gotten even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What an oddball. But you're my kind of
oddball.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You have to keep up with her passion,
Trainer. Can you do it?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No worries.
That's exactly what I intend to
do. A trainer never holds
back a racer from
pushing forward. Which is why...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No worries.
That's exactly what I intend to
do. A trainer never holds
back a racer from
pushing forward. Which is why...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Consecutive races?! That much passion
could be dangerous!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously your health takes priority.
But I
think you've got this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah... AAAGH! I'm gonna RACE!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna face this challenge head-on and
push through to the
Derby! And we'll do it
as a team, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now Trainer's all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Doubtless due to Ticket's influence. I'm
rather excited to see how
their story
unfolds.

Winning Ticket's story began with a
loss...

But she's only just starting out toward
her
goal.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Winning Ticket! Winning Ticket
wins the race!
Wooooo!

Winning Ticket overcomes the stress of
racing two weeks in a row and
claims her
first victory!
